text: Your account has been temporarily suspended due to unusual activity. Verify your identity within 24 hours: http://secure-bank-verify.xyz/login
why: secure-bank-verify.xyz stuffs security/finance words into the address (verify, secure, bank)
secure-bank-verify.xyz uses many hyphens, a common phishing pattern
'.xyz' is a low-cost TLD heavily used by phishing sites
domain model rates secure-bank-verify.xyz as phishing-like (P=0.98)
manipulation tactics: Urgency / time pressure, Authority impersonation, Fear / threat, Payment / credential request
advice: Do not click any link, call any number or reply.
Never share OTPs, PINs, passwords or card details.
Contact the organisation only via its official app or the number printed on your card/bill.
Report it to your bank (if money or cards are involved) and to your national cyber-crime or consumer-fraud authority.
Then delete the message and block the sender.
If you ALREADY clicked or replied: change the affected passwords, turn on two-factor authentication, call your bank to freeze cards/transfers if you shared financial details, and run a malware scan.
